name: vanta-director-free
description: A free, standalone cinematic scene editor for **FiveM GTA V Legacy**. Build short scenes with a camera timeline, characters, vehicles, objects, curated animations, lighting and weather controls. The editor can hide its interface for a clean take; use OBS or another recorder to capture the footage.

scripts.format: prettier --write web animations.json scripts tests *.md *.json && stylua --glob "**/*.lua" --glob "!node_modules/**" .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web animations.json scripts tests *.md *.json && stylua --check --glob "**/*.lua" --glob "!node_modules/**" .
